v0_aq_l_provider_audit.scope: This is a host-local availability audit for the independently parameterized V0-AQ-L molecular-liquid branch. It is not a statement that an upstream theory is invalid, a request to install a dependency, or a substitute for a frozen physical solvent asset.

jdftx_classical_dft.consequence: The documented JDFTx ClassicalDFT/fluid-solvent upstream route cannot be executed locally without a separately authorized, version-pinned installation and frozen asset source.

required_default_named_catalog_coverage.coverage_boundary: This is documented named-catalog overlap only, not host runtime support, a frozen physical asset, total-free-energy execution, or an accuracy result. Even after an authorized installation, custom source-complete assets or another verified functional are required for the two missing default solvents and all eleven still need the V0 physical-liquid admission gates.

jdftx_classical_dft.fitted_functional_policy: The name FittedCorrelations is not automatically admissible to the strict no-fit V0 core. It must remain excluded unless a separately reviewed source record proves that its fixed upstream construction is compatible with the V0 no-target/no-post-training policy; it may never be selected or retuned using Route-2 solvation errors.
jdftx_classical_dft.custom_property_override_policy: The documented epsBulk, epsInf, pMol, Pvap, sigmaBulk, Rvdw, Res, orientation-quadrature, and related overrides are an upstream input interface, not a custom-solvent constructor. A scalar property override cannot replace the Route-2 requirement for a source-bound molecular model or complete excess functional, bulk thermodynamics, short-range/dispersion convention, standard state, and no-target provenance.
jdftx_classical_dft.mace_common_scalar_boundary: A JDFTx joint electron-liquid scalar contains its own auxiliary electronic density and cannot be added directly to frozen MACE gas energy or to a MACE/RISM scalar. It can enter only through the separately declared V0-AQ gas-to-liquid auxiliary difference with identical auxiliary gas/liquid functionals and all stationary degrees of freedom; it must never relabel its density as MACE density or feed it into MACE field features.

ambertools_rism.stock_rism3d_requirement: The local rism3d.snglpnt help requires --pdb, --prmtop, and --xvv. Its stock solute interface therefore cannot be relabelled as a MACE-native auxiliary-QM or Gaussian-MACE source.
ambertools_rism.bundled_bulk_models: The installed rism1d data directory contains only the cSPCE bulk control plus ion models, not complete frozen assets for the eleven required default solvents.
ambertools_rism.consequence: AmberTools may remain a bulk-parser/control provenance source, but it is not an admissible V0-AQ-L physical endpoint without a separately derived MACE-native solute interaction, complete frozen solvent assets, and a common liquid free-energy/force functional.

v0_aq_l_provider_audit.decision: No local executable plus admitted eleven-solvent physical asset set exists for V0-AQ-L. Do not create a proxy endpoint, substitute a GAFF/AM1-BCC solute topology, or treat the rejected V0-AQ-E PCM control as a molecular-liquid result.

execution_policy: Total-free-energy execution is rejected until all required frozen solvent-side assets exist and later liquid-functional/force gates pass. No GAFF/AM1-BCC solute fallback, training, fine-tuning, MAP/UQ, calibration, response modification, or experiment-selected parameter change is permitted.

bulk_liquid_state_source_contract.not_an_admitted_asset: A source-only state certificate can validate independent scalar anchors and their RISM T/density/static-dielectric cross-check. It cannot derive finite-k direct correlations, a closure, short-range interaction, bridge, liquid functional, total solvation free energy, force, or accuracy result.

molecular_rism_bulk_state_source_contrac.state_domain_boundary: A fixed-charge molecular-RISM input cross-checks only T, molecular number density, and static epsilon(0). It has no separate solvent-electronic polarization variable, so epsilon(infinity) belongs only to the distinct nonlocal-dielectric continuum control. Neither state contract determines finite-k C_ab(k).
molecular_rism_bulk_state_source_contrac.not_an_admitted_asset: The DCM source-only scalar state record validates per-property provenance and exact MDL binding only. Its source-frozen KH/DRISM feasibility audit is a rejection of that exact nonconverged numerical candidate, not an admission or a parameter-search prompt. Neither record can provide a residual-converged finite-k correlation, a closure, a short-range interaction, bridge, stationary liquid functional, total solvation free energy, force, or accuracy result.
